facts.fact: ESCCOM's acting chief executive said the National Addressing Standard (SZN S ISO 19160) was launched in July 2026 as the culmination of the National Addressing and Postcode System Project begun in 2021, with Ezulwini and Matsapha projects at an advanced stage and preparatory work under way with the Tinkhundla ministry to extend addressing to rural communities.
facts.system: National Addressing and Postcode System Project

facts.fact: ESCCOM confirmed that Mbabane and Manzini have implemented the new addressing framework.
